fns.desc: eap_peap_process_phase2_soh's MS-vendor-specific-TLV handling only rejects tlv_len<4 before reading vpos=pos+4 and dereferencing vpos[0..3] (mandatory/tlv_type/vtlv_len) at :882-885; it never checks tlv_len>=8, so a peer-supplied SoH vendor TLV with tlv_len in [4,7] as the last TLV in the message causes vpos[0..3] to read 1-4 bytes past the validated buffer bound (the outer bounds check at :887 only fires after these reads already happened). Attacker-controlled EAP-TLV wire data, no crash guarantee but a genuine bounded over-read.
